newsitem.title: USA: First Union says unit completes $1.3 bln offering.
newsitem.headline: First Union says unit completes $1.3 bln offering.

text.p: First Union Capital Markets Corp and Lehman Brothers have completed a $1.3 billion offering of securities backed by multi-family and commercial mortgages, First Union said on Thursday.
The securities are backed by 283 fixed-rate commercial mortgage loans on various property types, including retail and hotel properties, the company said in a statement.
The securities represent the first issued off of First Union's commercial mortgage-backed securities shelf registration statement, it added.
First Union Capital Markets Corp is the investment banking subsidiary of Charlotte-based First Union Corp.
First Union Capital Markets Corp offers financial services including loan syndications, private placements, acquisition advisory and public finance.
First Union said the offering was the industry's second-largest commercial mortgage conduit securitization to date.
